description: The guest kernel's OOM killer killed a process (/proc/vmstat oom_kill rose); sent as the payload of a market.event. One record per rise, at most one per 10 min (a later one carries every kill since) and ten memory events per contract. Guest-originated only. It carries no secret.

kills.description: The kills since the last oomKill of this guest.

total.description: The guest's oom_kill count since boot.
